info.title: Anilife Cloud Sync API
info.description: Opt-in, local-first synchronization. This contract does not create live endpoints by itself.

servers.description: Production after an explicit deployment gate

200.description: All submitted operations were committed or previously acknowledged.

204.description: The authenticated account and its cloud data were deleted.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-anilife-session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, host-only session issued by the reviewed auth integration.

csrfHeader.name: X-Anilife-CSRF
csrfHeader.description: Session-bound CSRF value required with exact Origin validation on mutations.

NoStore.description: Private data must not enter a shared cache.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds before retry is permitted.

Bootstrap.description: A bounded snapshot page and registered device identifier.

Conflict.description: The whole submitted batch was rejected because a base revision was stale.

CursorExpired.description: The client must perform a bounded bootstrap without deleting its outbox.

RateLimited.description: Retry only after the server-supplied window.

Problem.description: A bounded machine-readable error without private details.
